summary: People Inc filed an 8-K on June 22, 2026, reporting the appointment of Christopher Currier as Chief Accounting Officer effective June 16, 2026, replacing Michael H. Schwerdtman who retired but remains as advisor through February 2027. Mr. Currier entered into a Retention Agreement providing accelerated vesting of RSUs if terminated without cause. The filing also discloses a Voting Agreement with Barry Diller and others. This is a routine officer change; no acquisition, divestiture, or other special situation is present. What to watch: any subsequent management shifts or strategic moves signaled by the voting agreement.
